notes.title: 《Whisper of the shade: Gray》 is ready on Steam!
notes.content:
[h3]
《Whisper of the shade: Gray》is ready on Steam![/h3]

Push open the wooden door, 
and a familiar aroma of coffee mingles perfectly with the gentle sweetness of pastries.

Take a seat by the window, 
bathed in the soft afternoon sunlight,as the greetings from the staff feel like a warm ray of sunshine.

The exclusive coffee shop, Grey Hawk, is now live on Steam.
We warmly welcome all our store managers to visit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145669/7c190c321f10c1540481872d15a1d246e4c00459.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 《Whisper of the shade: Gray》Steam Game & Male Protagonist Acrulic Stand
notes.content:
[b][h3]《Whisper of the shade: Gray》Steam Game &  Male Protagonist Acrulic Stand[/h3] [/b]

In the bustling city,
a café named Grey quietly opens its doors.
Everyone is busy sourcing ingredients and preparing dishes.

As you step into the café,
do you still feel a sense of familiarity with everything inside?

Stories and memories fill every corner,
and the prologue of love begins with you!

Wishing all the store managers a successful opening.
